about: Modwerk source-only input-prefader package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/input-prefader.

mods.title: Input Pre-Fader Sends
mods.summary: Takes the external inputs’ delay and reverb sends before their LEV, and can keep the effects awake with no track playing, so the Digitakt works as an effects box.
mods.description: Takes the external inputs’ delay and reverb sends before their LEV, and can keep the effects awake with no track playing, so the Digitakt works as an effects box.

mods.on_unit: The author reports this build tested on a Digitakt I, OS 1.54, alone and with Digi Health and Digi EQ (2026-10-20).
